demoBlurb.en: Services, areas covered and a quote form that lands on WhatsApp. Built to be found on Google.
demoBlurb.ga: Seirbhísí, ceantair clúdaithe agus foirm mheastacháin a thagann ar WhatsApp. Déanta le bheith aimsithe ar Google.

tagline.en: Fully qualified electrician for homes, farms and B&Bs across Connemara. Fast call-outs, fair prices.
tagline.ga: Leictreoir cáilithe do thithe, feirmeacha agus B&Banna ar fud Chonamara. Glaonna tapa, praghsanna córa.

en: Local, Safe Electric registered, and I turn up when I say I will. From a new socket to a full rewire, EV charger or heat-pump wiring, you get a clear price before any work starts.
ga: Áitiúil, cláraithe le Safe Electric, agus tagaim nuair a deirim go dtiocfaidh mé. Ó soicéad nua go hathshreangú iomlán, luchtaire EV nó sreangú teaschaidéil, gheobhaidh tú praghas soiléir sula dtosaíonn aon obair.

desc.en: Old houses, tripping fuses, flickering lights.
desc.ga: Seantithe, fiúsanna ag titim, soilse ag preabadh.
Suiteálacha a oireann do dheontais SEAI.

desc.en: For sales, rentals, B&Bs and insurance.
desc.ga: Do dhíolacháin, chíosanna, B&Banna agus árachas.

desc.en: Power out? Ring and I'll get to you.
desc.ga: Gan chumhacht? Glaoigh agus tiocfaidh mé.

text.en: Came out the same evening when our power went. Sorted in an hour, fair price.
text.ga: Tháinig sé amach an tráthnóna céanna nuair a chuaigh an chumhacht. Réitithe in uair an chloig, praghas cóir.

text.en: Wired our heat pump and dealt with the grant paperwork. Couldn't recommend more.
text.ga: Shreangaigh sé ár dteaschaidéal agus réitigh sé páipéarachas an deontais. Molaim go hard é.
